feature: least-request child policy inside ordinary Channel weighted_target

scope.completion: unary and streaming success/error terminal paths

contracts: weighted_target chooses only READY children and delegates to the selected child picker
least-request samples choiceCount READY endpoints with replacement
outstanding counts cannot cross hierarchical child-policy boundaries
a claimed count returns on construction failure or terminal completion

implementation.configuration: the recursive runtime retains each least-request choiceCount beyond ServiceConfig lifetime
implementation.membership: only reusable slots under the leaf hierarchical prefix enter the candidate set
implementation.sampling: power-of-N sampling reuses the shared gRFC A48 picker and permits duplicate samples
implementation.comparison: the sampled matching slot with the smallest outstanding request count wins
implementation.isolation: runtime slot configuration enables counting only for endpoints owned by a least-request leaf
implementation.unary_lifecycle: beginRequest increments before materialization and defer returns the count on all outcomes
implementation.stream_lifecycle: stream creation retains local cleanup ownership until an exactly-once completion observer accepts it
implementation.reconciliation: replacement slots are classified again before later picks

native_cases: a deterministic child-local picker gives one matching slot 100 outstanding requests and leaves its sibling at zero
more than 4000 of 4096 power-of-10 picks choose the low-load matching sibling
an equally idle slot under a different target receives zero picks and is not marked for least-request counting
two real h2c endpoints remain reachable through a choiceCount-10 child across 200 sequential RPCs
ServiceConfig is destroyed immediately after ordinary Channel initialization
recursive runtime construction including a least-request leaf passes every induced allocation failure

negative_boundary.hostname_targets: ordinary weighted-target remains limited to static resolved endpoints

verification_commands: zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='ordinary weighted target least request' --summary all
zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='ordinary weighted target runtime deep copy' --summary all
zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='gRPC ordinary weighted target' --summary all
remaining_gap: ordinary ring-hash, WRR, outlier, hostname runtime support and dynamic service-config child retention remain before broad parity
